payload.title: Membership needs the correct legal route and record
payload.core_explanation_md:
The statutory definition recognises the memorandum subscriber, the person agreeing in writing and entered in the member register, and the shareholding beneficial owner recorded by a depository. A company without share capital can have members without shareholders. Do not use a certificate-delivery event as the only possible membership test.

Allotment allocates shares; transfer and transmission arise through different routes. Death, nomination, legal representation and joint holdings require the relevant succession and record analysis rather than assuming that possession of a certificate settles beneficial ownership. Capacity, body-corporate powers and FEMA compliance can also matter. The textbook broad minor prohibition and insolvency summaries need specialist reconciliation before being used to decide a live holding.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a depository beneficial-owner record matter to membership?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Yes. It is expressly recognised in the described definition.

payload.stem_md: A person holds shares and is entered as beneficial owner in depository records. A note rejects membership solely because no paper certificate was delivered. What was omitted?

options.explanation_md: Membership is not confined to paper delivery.

options.text_md: A requirement that all companies have no share capital
options.explanation_md: Companies can have share capital; the membership definition separately recognises depository beneficial-owner records.

options.text_md: A rule that certificates always determine succession

options.explanation_md: It is not the membership test.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Membership is not confined to paper delivery.

payload.stem_md: A holding changes after a member death. Why should the file distinguish transmission from an ordinary sale transfer?

options.text_md: Both always require an identical sale contract
The legal basis and required evidence differ
options.explanation_md: Succession and record requirements must be established.
